name: NASA SVS Milky Way 2020 background
display_color_space: sRGB via Blender Standard, exposure 0, gamma 1
credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio. Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC.
mapping: Plate carree/equirectangular celestial ICRF/J2000; RA 0h centered, RA increases leftward; designed for spherical mapping.
source_kind: Catalog-derived visualization, 1.7-billion-star source catalog family. Bright Hipparcos/Tycho foreground omitted; faint Gaia points remain.
alteration: Native-size display conversion and RGB8 quantization only. No sharpening, resampling, compositing or artistic change.
raw_exr_policy: 137307727-byte original stays ignored; reacquire only from exact source URL and verify SHA256 before conversion.
runtime_policy: Candidate texture plus one override on MI_SpaceMilkyWay; no automatic runtime selection or global texture/quality changes.
